result.title: Beyond Entity Recognition: Vision-Centric Knowledge Visual Question Answering
result.summary: We propose VC-VQA, a large-scale benchmark for vision-centric knowledge reasoning, aiming to systematically evaluate the capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) in fine-grained visual knowledge acquisition and complex multi-stage reasoning. Unlike existing benchmarks that primarily treat visual information as entity recognition and rely on text-based external knowledge, VC-VQA explicitly models the role of visual information by considering both its source (internal vs. external images) and stage of involvement (pre-retrieval vs. post-retrieval). Specifically, VC-VQA requires models to retrieve external visual evidence, identify visual clues before retrieval, and localize, verify, or match retrieved knowledge against the internal image. We further construct a controlled multimodal knowledge base with traceable textual and visual evidence for each sample. We evaluate 21 representative MLLMs under four settings: no external knowledge, with provided evidence, knowledge base retrieval, and open-web search. Experimental results lead to three key findings: current models still struggle with vision-centric knowledge reasoning; fine-grained visual knowledge acquisition remains the primary bottleneck; and agentic retrieval highlights the value of multi-step planning and cross-modal knowledge integration. Overall, VC-VQA provides a more challenging benchmark for evaluating vision-centric knowledge reasoning in MLLMs. Our code and dataset are available at https://github.com/CASIA-IVA-Lab/VC-VQA.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 VC-VQA 基准，按视觉信息来源（内部／外部图像）与介入阶段（检索前／检索后）刻画视觉信息在知识推理中的作用，要求模型检索外部视觉证据、定位并核验视觉线索，并在四种知识获取设置下评测 21 个 MLLM。
AI.relevance_reason: 与视觉证据筛选、检索前后线索定位及多步获取决策的兴趣直接相关，其失败分析（细粒度视觉知识获取为主要瓶颈、agentic 检索收益）可供核查 LOOK 步骤的必要性与成本。
